decisions.reason: It fits our core stollen know-how and has repeated gold-medal validation, giving us clear evidence that our existing capabilities can keep converting it into sales and reputation.

This bread remains close to our established rye-baking knowledge and has survived while other new bread variants were removed, although the lack of explicit performance signals leaves a meaningful pruning risk.

As a marzipan stollen it is highly related to our existing confectionery skills and seasonal assortment, so it is inexpensive for us to maintain and improve even without the stronger external signal seen for product B.
